ALL ROBOT WAR: Ukraine sent at least 28 unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) from its 3rd Army Corps against Russia’s 20th Combined Arms Army in the Lyman sector on 28 October, in what they call the largest all-robot assault of the war. 
Russian accounts say the force had 18 UGVs armed with twin 84mm AT4-type launchers, 2 with Mk 19 40mm automatic grenade launchers and 8 explosive-laden kamikaze vehicles. 
They say reconnaissance detected the column and that FPV and munition-dropping drones repelled it. 
Some call it the first major offensive attempt with no infantry, a “platoon of robots,” and a warning that UGVs are moving from logistics toward independent strike roles.
